name: A payment toward a closed period is still allocated to its oldest debt
title: SC-13-02-11 A payment toward a closed period is still allocated to its oldest debt
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F7
When the manager records a manual payment of 1675.00 for unit "A-3"
Then the "Eylül 2026" liability is settled
And the payment is booked in the open November period and the September snapshot is unchanged
And the ledger invariants hold
